title: Reinforcement of the Forward Cargo Door Surround Lower Corner Fittings at Frames C22 to C26

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Fuselage Section 13 — Forward — Door Surround Structure

abstract: Titanium corner fittings and a re-radiused cut-out at the forward cargo door of the CIRRANE-11, closing a static margin shortfall found when the shorter fuselage was re-analysed against the revised freight loading case.

sections.reason: Re-analysis of the CIRRANE-11 forward cargo door cut-out against the revised high-density freight loading case showed a static reserve factor of 1.02 at the lower corner fittings, below the 1.15 target the programme applies to door surrounds. The shorter fuselage puts the door closer to the wing carry-through and the corner therefore sees a higher shear flow than the equivalent CIRRANE-13 station. Nothing had been found in service and no operator symptom exists; the change closes an analysis gap that the original certification loading case had not covered.
sections.description: The four aluminium corner fittings at the forward cargo door cut-out are replaced by machined titanium items and the cut-out corner radius is increased from 40 mm to 55 mm. The gusset D5321130372071 is replaced, the intercostal D5321133887188 is retained but re-drilled to the new fastener pattern, and the door surround stringer D5321132983318 gains a local doubler at the lower run-out. The joint is fastened with titanium bolts AES495354-07 to a wet assembly. Revised detail is on drawings D53211308437 and D53211305153. Access is through the forward cargo compartment in zones 111 and 113, with the door in the maintenance position and the sill panel in zone 891 removed.
sections.effects: Mass increase of 4.1 kg per aircraft, offset to the left of the centre line by the single door position, with a lateral moment inside the reporting threshold. No electrical load change. The fittings are not interchangeable with the aluminium standard because both the fastener pattern and the corner radius change, so a mixed installation on one door surround is not permitted. The 8 000 flight cycle detailed visual inspection introduced by the re-analysis is withdrawn after embodiment. Repair content for the door surround corner has to be re-issued because the increased radius changes the allowable damage boundary.
sections.embodiment_note: Cut in on the CIRRANE-11 production line at MSN C00466 in August 2021. Delivered CIRRANE-11 aircraft are brought to standard through Service Bulletin CRN-53-1021, which takes about five days inside a scheduled C-check. The CIRRANE-13 is not affected and no equivalent change is planned for it.

type_data.balance_impact: Single-side installation, lateral moment below reporting threshold
type_data.production_impact: Cut-in at MSN C00466 on the CIRRANE-11 line only
